title: Chrome 157 beta adds CSS and timing tools as DeepSeek opens search APIs
summary: Chrome's October 15 beta previews native underline spacing and more detailed animation-frame timing. DeepSeek's October 17 Search and Fetch APIs give applications structured access to live web content.
imageAlt: A browser panel with an underlined text line and timing bars connected to a search lens and document
imageCaption: Original illustration of browser styling and timing tools alongside web search and retrieval; not a product screenshot.

sections.heading: An underline control and clearer frame diagnostics
paragraphs: The Chrome 157 beta, announced on October 15, includes CSS text-decoration-inset. It controls where an underline, overline, or line-through begins and ends relative to the text, including length and percentage values. For interface work, that offers a native way to tune a decoration or create a reveal effect without an extra element or background-gradient workaround.

The beta also adds styleDuration and forcedStyleDuration to Long Animation Frame entries, helping developers separate style and layout time while investigating slow frames. These are beta-channel features, not a claim of broad browser support: Chrome Status currently schedules the stable release for November 3. Check support and keep fallbacks before using either in production.

sections.heading: Search and retrieval become separate AI building blocks
paragraphs: On October 17, DeepSeek opened its Search and Fetch APIs. Search returns structured web results for a query; Fetch retrieves one page as Markdown. Both are standalone JSON endpoints authenticated with a DeepSeek API key, so an application can retrieve sources before passing selected material to a model rather than treating the model's memory as current web evidence.

DeepSeek says a request is billable only when it returns HTTP 200 with a nonempty result or page content. Its documentation lists separate rate limits and notes that Fetch can fail when a target site's availability or access policy blocks retrieval. For a browser-facing AI feature, keep the API key on the server, review retrieved pages and their dates, and test answer quality independently; the provider's search-quality claims are not a guarantee that every result is reliable.

zh-TW.title: Chrome 157 beta 加入 CSS 與效能工具，DeepSeek 開放搜尋 API
zh-TW.summary: Chrome 10 月 15 日的 beta 預覽更細緻的文字裝飾位置與影格耗時資訊；DeepSeek 10 月 17 日開放 Search 和 Fetch API，讓應用程式能取得即時網頁內容。
zh-TW.imageAlt: 瀏覽器面板中的底線文字與效能時間條，連接到搜尋放大鏡和文件
zh-TW.imageCaption: 以瀏覽器樣式、效能分析與網頁搜尋擷取為題的原創插畫，並非產品截圖。

sections.heading: 底線位置更好控制，慢影格也更容易拆解
paragraphs: Chrome 於 10 月 15 日推出的 157 beta 包含 CSS text-decoration-inset，可調整底線、頂線與刪除線相對於文字起迄位置的內縮或外延，支援長度與百分比。對介面開發而言，這提供了不必增加元素或借用背景漸層，就能微調文字裝飾與揭露效果的原生方式。
這次 beta 也為 Long Animation Frame 紀錄加入 styleDuration 與 forcedStyleDuration，協助開發者在追查慢影格時區分樣式與版面計算耗時。這些仍屬 beta 功能，不代表已獲所有瀏覽器支援；Chrome Status 目前將穩定版排定於 11 月 3 日。正式採用前仍應確認支援情況並保留替代方案。

sections.heading: 搜尋與擷取成為可獨立使用的 AI 元件
paragraphs: DeepSeek 於 10 月 17 日開放 Search 與 Fetch API。Search 對查詢回傳結構化網頁結果，Fetch 則將單一頁面擷取為 Markdown；兩者都是使用 DeepSeek API 金鑰驗證的獨立 JSON 端點。應用程式可以先取得來源，再把選定內容交給模型，而不必把模型記憶當成即時網路證據。
DeepSeek 文件指出，只有 HTTP 200 且確實取得結果或頁面內容的請求才計費；兩個 API 各有限速，Fetch 也可能因目標網站的可用性或存取規則而失敗。若要做給瀏覽器使用的 AI 功能，應把金鑰留在伺服器端、檢查來源與日期，並自行測試回答品質；供應商對搜尋品質的宣稱，不等於每筆結果都可靠。
